label: Bible Study
prompt: He that _____ not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verse: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
note: Paul's logic — if God gave his own Son, what good thing would he hold back?

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their _____.
verse: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
note: Rain in due season and trees yielding fruit — God's farm report for a faithful people.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of _____: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verse: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
note: Paul's spiritual alarm clock: it's high time to awake out of sleep — salvation is nearer than when we believed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the _____ of our lips.
verse: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
note: Hosea's repentance script: instead of bulls on the altar, offer the 'calves' of your lips — words of praise.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wisdom is the _____ thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verse: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
note: 'Wisdom is the principal thing' — principal, not principle: the chief thing. So get it, whatever it costs.
